scope: Isolated browser-native result target: every playable CharacterKind is constructed by the original demo-fighter path, animated for 60 steps, submitted through the original fighter callback, captured through the native result camera into a 52x74 RGB5A3 image, attached to the original result-panel material, and fully torn down. This is not evidence for live match-to-results lifecycle or result-screen FPS.
checksPerCase: requested external CharacterKind and exact internal FighterKind
finite initial and post-animation actor state
winner camera submits all three native passes
winner GPU draws, verified vertices, and non-black pixels
loser camera GPU draws and verified vertices
exact portrait address bound once by the original panel material
zero actor, panel, process, and resident-file leaks
